LanguageData.Mugirl.label: Mugirl
LanguageData.Mugirl.description: A half-muffalo race genetically engineered by a mega corporation, possessing soft fur, light blue coats and adorable horns. They combine strength with a gentle nature, being intelligent and affectionate, yet are forced to endure a life of servitude. Despite this, they still comfort those around them with tender gestures, demonstrating a remarkable kindness inherent to their character.
